summary: Full backend regression run for Voltcut. All 11 pytest tests passed in ~37s including the full AI pipeline (GPT scene split + OpenAI TTS + Whisper-1 word alignment + Pixabay/mock image), FFmpeg render lifecycle, and MP4 file serving.

minor.issue: Always returns HTTP 200 even when nothing matched (deleted: 0). Consider returning 404 when project not found for stricter semantics.
Accepts arbitrary dict payload (no Pydantic model). Could allow clients to overwrite protected fields such as id/created_at. Add a typed UpdateProject model with allowed fields.
Uses `type` as a query param which shadows Python builtin and is a reserved word in some clients. Consider renaming to `media_type` (param alias acceptable).

action_items: Optional: tighten PATCH /api/projects/{id} payload via Pydantic model (currently accepts dict).
Optional: return 404 from DELETE /api/projects/{id} when nothing was deleted.
Optional: replace `type` query param with `media_type` in /api/library/search.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes route handlers with background task and serialization helpers — fine at this size but if it grows past 700 lines split into routers (projects/render/library/meta).

render_service.py uses subprocess.run (blocking) inside an async path called from BackgroundTasks. It works because BackgroundTasks runs the coroutine in a worker but each scene blocks the event loop for several seconds. Consider asyncio.create_subprocess_exec for non-blocking ffmpeg calls.

render_project caption drawtext chain escapes commas but `_ffmpeg_escape` also escapes commas globally — that yields `\,` inside the regex content which is acceptable but double-escapes when wrapped by the chained filtergraph; smoke tests pass, but very long caption lists with edge characters may break — add unit tests around _build_caption_filter.
ai_service.transcribe_words has a graceful fallback when Whisper returns no word timestamps — good. duration uses `max(2.0, len(text.split())*0.4)` only when align duration is 0 — already covered.
pixabay_service mock fallback is intentional (no PIXABAY_API_KEY). Documented and verified.
All endpoints exclude `_id` correctly via projection ({"_id": 0}) and explicit doc.pop in serializers — good MongoDB hygiene.
seed_data_creation: Test creates and deletes TEST_blank_project and TEST_generated projects within the run (cleanup at end). One render MP4 left under /app/storage/renders/ as ffmpeg output; cleanup not implemented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. The pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is ordered (state dict carries IDs across tests) — run as a single module. Generation test uses a 1-sentence script and completes in ~25s; render polling timeout is 100s. If retesting, just re-run `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Pixabay key is intentionally empty so library returns curated Unsplash mock — do not flag as bug.
